name: Lute Wilson
source:
Affiliation: Knight School
Hobby: Bird Watching
Special Skill: Reading Aloud
Likes: All Animals
Dislikes: Nothing in Particular

A knight. Ark's childhood friend, he's always getting pushed into cleaning up after him.
He doesn't like fighting and gets along with everybody.
He's very curious about the world and likes books more than the sword, he doesn't like how Arolandia is such an insular country.
